notes.title: Update 19092015-1945
notes.notes:
We finnally added a full controller support, including a new keybinding system which will be found under the Options.

We also changed the look of the timer, since the timer gets the most hate at the mails which we receive. It has now his own background and a flashy effect if the time runs out.

We also finished the co-op mode and are testing now with our beta testers, after finishing these tests, it will get released to the public.

Sincerely,
~ Synter Games

notes.title: Critical Update
notes.notes:
We just got informed that there was a bug with the level selecting stuff.


We fixed it and made an update, if your game did not update yet, please restart steam to get a working game flow.

notes.title: Credits, general update & Facebook
notes.notes:
Hello,

since some peoples asked me why we don't give some credits
to AwfulMedia since its based on his contept.

Well we forgot the credits screen / button which got added now and yes hes in it...

We also changed some movement code to get a smoother movement and we decided to translate our facebook page (http://facebook.com/syntergames to englisch too, since we all are from switzerland we are sorry for some small mistakes which will appear maybe.

We got in contact with AwfulMedia and he would like to play our game, what makes us very happy and we sponsored him 25 game keys which he will give away to his subscribers so be sure to check it out
-> http://youtube.com/awfulmedia
